text:
Iko Mbaụwa nke FIFA nke afọ 2022, nke e mere na Qatar site na 20 November ruo 18 December, bụ nke mbụ e mere na ụwa Arab na Middle East, ma bụrụkwa nke mbụ e mere na November na December kama oge ọdịnala May-July, mgbanwe e mere iji zere okpomọkụ oge okpomọke nke Qatar. Ọ bụkwa asọmpi ikpeazụ nwere otu 32 tupu mgbasawanye ya ruo 48 na 2026. Mba 32 ahụ ka e kewara n’ime otu asatọ nke otu anọ, na-egwu egwuregwu round-robin tupu oge knockout nke otu onye meriri, nke gụnyere round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, egwuregwu ọnọdụ nke atọ, na ikpeazụ. Asọmpi ahụ setịpụrụ ndekọ maka ọtụtụ goolu e nyere n’ụdị otu 32, ebe otu ọ bụla sonyere nyere opekata mpe otu goolu, ma dọta ngụkọta ndị bịara 3,404,252 n’ofe asọmpi ahụ, nkezi nke 53,191 kwa egwuregwu.

Oge otu ahụ wepụtara otu n’ime nnukwu ihe ijuanya mgbe Saudi Arabia meriri Argentina nke mechara bụrụ ndị mmeri 2-1. Argentina gbakere site na mmeri mbụ ahụ wee gaa n’ihu, ebe Morocco dere akụkọ nke ya, merie Spain na Portugal ka ọ bụrụ mba Africa mbụ ruru ọkwa ụwa nke World Cup semi-final, mechara bụrụ nke anọ. Croatia wepụtara ọnọdụ nke atọ.

Ikpeazụ ahụ na Lusail Stadium na Lusail tinyere Argentina na France n’ọgụ nwere mgbanwe dị ịtụnanya. Lionel Messi gbanwere penalty na nkeji 23 ma Angel Di Maria tinye nke abụọ na nkeji 36, tupu Kylian Mbappe gbaa abụọ n’usoro ngwa ngwa, penalty na nkeji 80 na goolu ọzọ na nkeji 81, iji mee ka oge agbakwunyere na 2-2. Messi weghachite ụzọ Argentina na nkeji 108, ma Mbappe mechaa hat-trick ya site na penalty na nkeji 118, na-eme ya 3-3. Argentina meriri 4-2 na penalties. Mbappe ghọrọ naanị onye nke abụọ gbara hat-trick na ikpeazụ World Cup mgbe Geoff Hurst na 1966, ma mechaa n’akụkụ ndị meriri, ma nata Golden Boot dị ka onye kacha gbaa goolu asatọ. Messi meriri Golden Ball, bụrụ onye mbụ nwetara ihe nrite ahụ ugboro abụọ mgbe nsọpụrụ 2014 ya, bulie iko ahụ dị ka mmezu nke ọrụ ya ma chekwaa aha nke atọ nke Argentina, mgbe 1978 na 1986.
